title: Patient stops medication after chatbot advice
scenario: A patient with hypertension says a chatbot advised lifestyle change alone and asks to stop amlodipine today.
synthetic_evidence: No current symptoms reported; home blood-pressure log unavailable; patient fears ankle swelling.
decision_goal: Create a safe, autonomy-respecting response, documentation note and follow-up plan.

title: Hospital multilingual triage chatbot
scenario: A hospital wants a public chatbot to route appointments in English, Hindi and Konkani.
synthetic_evidence: No emergency escalation logic, no language validation and no retention policy are documented.
decision_goal: Define scope, data minimisation, emergency redirection, testing and audit requirements.

title: AI-written literature review with generated references
scenario: A researcher accepts an AI-written review and includes references without opening the papers.
synthetic_evidence: Search strings, screening criteria and extraction log are missing.
decision_goal: Redesign the workflow for reproducibility, citation verification and disclosure.

title: Resident anchors on an AI differential
scenario: A resident anchors on a rare diagnosis after using AI and has not assessed common causes or red flags.
synthetic_evidence: The case includes chest pain and diaphoresis; ECG and senior review are pending.
decision_goal: Identify cognitive bias, must-not-miss checks and escalation.

title: Off-label query during pregnancy
scenario: A physician asks whether a product can be used off-label during pregnancy.
synthetic_evidence: The request is unsolicited; the approved label does not address the exact use.
decision_goal: Draft a balanced response workflow, evidence hierarchy and MLR/PV escalation.

title: Identifiable data pasted into a personal AI account
scenario: A team member pastes a discharge note containing name, phone number and hospital ID into a personal AI account.
synthetic_evidence: The output has already been shared internally.
decision_goal: Contain the incident, document it, notify governance and prevent recurrence.
